title: Taylor hospitalized with injuries from ranch phenomena

tellings.quote: He had to go to the hospital because of injuries and he's had things happen that have followed him.

plain: A man named Travis Taylor, who has worked at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah ranch known for reports of strange happenings, is said to have ended up in hospital with injuries from what goes on there, and to have had strange things follow him after he left. The ranch's owner tells this on Michels' show, passing on what happened to Taylor, as a sign that whatever is at the ranch can harm people.
